verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of retention settings, retention periods, auto-delete schedules, or per-recording or bulk deletion controls. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: a training-data opt-out arranged through an account manager, audit logging, and a community remark about deleting an account. The documented capability for this story is absent, so the verdict is none.
